Name: Replace Fertilizer
Author: Amojingshen
Description:
This mod allows the player to easily replace another fertilizer even if there's already one in the dirt.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Now you will be allowed to apply a fertilizer when there's already another fertilizer in the dirt.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]Source code: https://github.com/jingshenSN2/ReplaceFertilizer
[/list]
